tool_args.rationale: The pilot combines sink-gradient sensitivity with a possible endogenous adaptation signature, while all observations have H ≤ 0.48 versus a target H of 22.5. The slow-horizon probe directly tests the long-timescale behavior needed to distinguish the archived sink-coupled adaptation mechanism.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations cannot reliably identify five parameters or constrain the slow response at the target horizon.
Fine short-horizon trajectories are less directly informative about slow adaptation and long-horizon reversal.
The short-window observations do not distinguish a static response from slow adaptation.
